author: trayvash
body: Make sure to use your coins. Also work on getting eq that boost's orns. If your at the end of t7 I believe you have some access to good farming eq now but you definitely will once you hit t8. Lsot helmets drop from headless which only spawn at night. Depending on class you either want to find cuthulu, nin-kiln, or ankou for a weapon. Spellings may be incorrect but I'm sure you can understand. The fan made gudie is a great resource for info on all those mobs and eq.

author: mum2afew
body: I found it hard in t6/t7, but Boss and hard mode gauntlets at once going one tier below you will give you a lot or orns, uses a lot of keys, but worth it, also use your coins, fight bosses, explore areas and don't forget your daily quests and keep quests, that will give you orns.
